summary: Tungray Technologies filed a Form 6-K disclosing undisclosed guarantees by its subsidiary Tongri Electric for loans of Fudingtai, a related party controlled by CEO Wanjun Yao, totaling up to RMB110 million across multiple lenders. The Audit Committee engaged independent legal counsel on August 15, 2026, to review the guarantees; litigation by CCB is pending. No conclusions reached; potential material adverse effect uncertain. Watch for review outcomes, legal costs, or potential restatement.
